skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of entrepreneurship, classify types of entrepreneurial ventures, understand the process and mindset of entrepreneurship.
Recognize entrepreneurs and business owners, understand the qualities of successful entrepreneurs.
Understand the steps needed to prepare for starting a business.
Identify opportunities for business, develop skills to recognize business opportunities.
Understand the role and content of a business plan.
Develop dynamic and diverse teamwork skills.
Develop communication skills through group assignments and presentations.
Develop skills to handle data, synthesize information, and solve problems.
Develop self-study skills, accumulate and enhance professional knowledge.
Develop awareness of professional ethics and social responsibility.
